tool.name: HunyuanVideo
tool.summary: Tencent's open-weights 13B dual-stream text-to-video foundation model delivering cinema-quality 720p 24fps video clips with exceptional physics consistency.
tool.architecture: Dual-stream Diffusion Transformer (DiT) integrating 3D VAE with text-video cross-attention.
tool.usage:
from diffusers import HunyuanVideoPipeline
pipe = HunyuanVideoPipeline.from_pretrained("Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanVideo", torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
video = pipe("Astronaut riding a horse on the moon, cinematic 4k").frames[0]
tool.benchmarks: VBench Total: 85.2% (Top ranked open-source text-to-video model)
tool.limitations: High VRAM requirements (recommended 44GB+ for unquantized inference).
